question: In the cabinet of which Prime Minister of India, Dr. Manmohan Singh became the finance minister for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P V Narasimha Rao**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dr. Manmohan Singh became India’s Finance Minister in 1991, during a time of severe economic crisis.
 
• The Indian economy was facing a balance of payments crisis, with foreign exchange reserves barely enough to finance a few weeks of imports.
